rules.description: Data at rest or in transit is not encrypted.
rules.remediation: Enable AWS KMS encryption for data at rest and enforce TLS 1.2+ in transit via ALB/CloudFront listeners.

rules.description: No IAM-based access control detected.
rules.remediation: Define IAM roles and policies with least-privilege permissions. Use IAM Access Analyzer to detect overly broad access.

rules.description: Resources are not isolated within a VPC.
rules.remediation: Deploy all compute and data resources inside a VPC with private subnets. Use security groups and NACLs to restrict traffic.

rules.description: No Web Application Firewall (WAF) detected.
rules.remediation: Attach AWS WAF to CloudFront or ALB with managed rule groups (AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet) to block OWASP Top 10.

rules.description: No KMS key management referenced for encryption.
rules.remediation: Use AWS KMS customer-managed keys (CMKs) for S3, RDS, EBS, and Secrets Manager. Enable automatic annual key rotation.

rules.description: No Multi-AZ deployment detected — single point of failure.
rules.remediation: Enable Multi-AZ for RDS and ElastiCache. Distribute ECS/EC2 across at least two Availability Zones behind an ALB.

rules.description: No backup strategy mentioned for data durability.
rules.remediation: Enable automated backups on RDS with a retention window of at least 7 days. Use AWS Backup for centralised cross-service policies.

rules.description: No failover mechanism detected.
rules.remediation: Configure RDS Multi-AZ for automatic failover. Use Route 53 health checks with failover routing policies for cross-region DR.

rules.description: No health checks configured for service endpoints.
rules.remediation: Configure ALB target group health checks with appropriate thresholds. Add ECS container health checks to replace unhealthy tasks automatically.

rules.description: No Auto Scaling policy detected for capacity management.
rules.remediation: Define Auto Scaling policies for ECS services or EC2 Auto Scaling Groups. Use target-tracking policies based on CPU or ALB request count.

rules.description: No caching layer detected to reduce latency.
rules.remediation: Introduce ElastiCache (Redis) for session and query caching, or DAX for DynamoDB. Apply the cache-aside pattern for frequently read data.

rules.description: No CDN referenced for static asset delivery.
rules.remediation: Front static assets and API responses with CloudFront. Configure cache behaviours and TTLs to maximise the edge cache-hit ratio.

rules.description: CloudFront not used for edge content delivery.
rules.remediation: Create a CloudFront distribution backed by your ALB or S3 origin. Enable HTTP/2, compression, and Origin Shield for improved cache efficiency.

rules.description: No load balancer detected for traffic distribution.
rules.remediation: Place an Application Load Balancer in front of the compute tier. Use weighted target groups for canary and blue/green deployments.

rules.description: No Reserved Instances or Savings Plans mentioned.
rules.remediation: Commit to 1- or 3-year Reserved Instances or Compute Savings Plans for baseline compute. Savings of up to 72% vs on-demand are achievable.

rules.description: Spot Instances not considered for fault-tolerant workloads.
rules.remediation: Use EC2 Spot or Fargate Spot for batch, CI/CD, and stateless workers. Implement interruption handling to cut compute costs by up to 90%.

rules.description: No Savings Plan referenced for compute cost reduction.
rules.remediation: Analyse Savings Plan coverage in Cost Explorer. A 1-year no-upfront Compute Savings Plan typically saves 20–40% over on-demand pricing.

rules.description: No S3 lifecycle policy detected for storage cost management.
rules.remediation: Define S3 lifecycle rules to transition objects to S3-IA after 30 days and Glacier after 90 days. Enable Intelligent-Tiering for unpredictable access.

rules.description: No monitoring strategy detected.
rules.remediation: Implement CloudWatch metrics, dashboards, and Container Insights for ECS. Define SLIs and SLOs and alert when error budgets are consumed.

rules.description: CloudWatch not referenced for observability.
rules.remediation: Enable CloudWatch Container Insights and create custom metric namespaces for business KPIs. Build per-service operational dashboards.

rules.description: No logging mechanism mentioned for audit trails.
rules.remediation: Enable VPC Flow Logs, ALB access logs, and CloudTrail for full API auditing. Centralise log delivery to S3 with lifecycle policies.

rules.description: No CI/CD pipeline detected for deployment automation.
rules.remediation: Implement a CI/CD pipeline with CodePipeline + CodeBuild or GitHub Actions. Automate integration tests, security scans, and blue/green deployments.

rules.description: No CloudWatch alarms configured for proactive alerting.
rules.remediation: Create CloudWatch alarms for p99 latency, error rate, and CPU utilisation. Use composite alarms and route notifications to SNS for on-call paging.

rules.description: Graviton processors not considered for energy efficiency.
rules.remediation: Migrate ECS tasks and RDS instances to Graviton (arm64). Graviton3 delivers up to 60% better energy efficiency vs comparable x86 instances.

rules.description: No rightsizing strategy mentioned to reduce waste.
rules.remediation: Enable AWS Compute Optimizer and act on its recommendations monthly. Use Cost Explorer rightsizing reports to eliminate overprovisioned resources.

rules.description: Serverless architecture not considered for sustainability.
rules.remediation: Evaluate Lambda or Fargate for event-driven workloads. Serverless eliminates idle capacity and reduces energy consumption proportional to actual usage.

rules.description: No resource efficiency strategy referenced.
rules.remediation: Enable the AWS Customer Carbon Footprint Tool to track emissions. Target high utilisation through bin-packing and consolidation of underused resources.
